## Checks

- [ ] `node ../mocks/scripts/bank/validate.ts .` passes
- [ ] `node ../mocks/scripts/bank/length-audit.ts .` reviewed, new findings are explained
- [ ] 4 options, exactly one correct, unique IDs, no duplicate option text
- [ ] Explanation and rationales never mention option numbers
- [ ] Wording follows `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` (people-first language, no outdated or dehumanising terms)
- [ ] Question meets `ACCESSIBILITY.md` (linear reading, no visual-only meaning, no option-number references)
- [ ] References are public and current, and `sourceCheckedAt` is set
- [ ] `reviewer` and `reviewedAt` are set by the person who verified the answer
- [ ] `bank.version` bumped if the question set changed
- [ ] No images, no `TODO`, no app code, no IAAP exam content
- [ ] Contribution licensed CC BY-SA 4.0
